text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E at large losses, then selling Stock B at a loss too, reminds me to set clear reasons and rules for exits rather than react emotionally to losses.","My recent trades did not prevent the account from falling overall; I should judge decisions over time and compare results with the market, not assume trading improves returns.","I should avoid concentrating decisions in a few stocks and keep enough cash to stay flexible when prices move against me."]}
